```{r}
#| message: false
here::i_am("dplyr-101.Rproj")
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(vroom)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
account <- vroom(here("Financial", "account.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    account_id = col_integer(),
    district_id = col_integer(),
    frequency = col_character(),
    date = col_date(format = ""),
    .delim = ","
  )
)
client <- vroom("Financial/client.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    client_id = col_integer(),
    gender = col_factor(levels = c("F", "M")),
    birth_date = col_date(format = ""),
    district_id = col_integer(),
    .delim = ","
  )
)
disp <- vroom(here("Financial", "disp.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    disp_id = col_integer(),
    client_id = col_integer(),
    account_id = col_integer(),
    type = col_factor(levels = c("OWNER", "DISPONENT")),
    .delim = ","
  )
)
```

```{r}
account |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 30)
```

## Joining two tables

### Inner join

```{r}
dc <- inner_join(disp, client, by = join_by(client_id))
```


```{r}
dc |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gender, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill")
```


```{r}
dc |>
  summarise(n=n(), .by=c(gender, type)) |>
  mutate(freq = n/sum(n), .by = gender) |>
  select(!n) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = freq)
```
```{r}
set.seed(0)
B <- data.frame(
  b_id = 1:6,
  Y = sample(1:3, size = 6, replace =TRUE),
  Z = sample(letters, size = 6)
)
A <- data.frame(
  a_id = 1:4,
  X = seq(0, 1, length.out = 4),
  b_id = B |> slice_sample(n = 4, replace = TRUE) |> pull(b_id)
)
```


```{r}
inner_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id))
```

```{r}
inner_join(B, A, by = join_by(b_id))
```


```{r}
inner_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id == Y))
```

```{r}
inner_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id < Y))
```
### Outer joins

```{r}
left_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id == Y))
```

```{r}
right_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id == Y))
```

```{r}
full_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id == Y))
```
